mapper.select: select d.dimension_code, d.group_code, d.group_name, d.dimension_name, d.description, d.weight, s.score, s.confidence, s.evidence, coalesce(s.graph_status, 'EMPTY') graph_status, coalesce(s.graph_version, 0) graph_version, coalesce(s.profile_kind, 'UNKNOWN') profile_kind, coalesce(s.conflict_flag, '0') conflict_flag, coalesce(s.inference_method, 'NONE') inference_method, coalesce(s.source_count, 0) source_count, s.graph_relation_ids, s.graph_entity_ids, s.graph_evidence_ids, coalesce(s.graph_path_count, 0) graph_path_count, s.profile_rule_version, case when s.score_id is null then 'INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE' when s.conflict_flag = '1' then 'CONFLICT' else 'AVAILABLE' end data_status, s.update_time from expert_dimension_definition d left join expert_graph_score s on s.dimension_code = d.dimension_code and s.user_id = #{userId} and s.graph_status = #{status} where d.enabled = '0' order by d.sort_no
mapper.insert: insert into expert_review_log (user_id, material_id, action, reviewer_id, reviewer_name, previous_status, current_status, comment, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{materialId}, #{action}, #{reviewerId}, #{reviewerName}, #{previousStatus}, #{currentStatus}, #{comment}, sysdate())

select , u.user_name, coalesce(p.real_name, u.nick_name) real_name from expert_status_request r left join expert_profile p on p.user_id = r.user_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = r.user_id where r.request_id = #{requestId} for update

select , u.user_name, coalesce(p.real_name, u.nick_name) real_name from expert_status_request r left join expert_profile p on p.user_id = r.user_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = r.user_id where r.user_id = #{userId} and r.request_status = 'PENDING' order by r.request_id desc limit 1

select , u.user_name, coalesce(p.real_name, u.nick_name) real_name from expert_status_request r left join expert_profile p on p.user_id = r.user_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = r.user_id where r.user_id = #{userId} order by r.request_id desc limit 20

select r.request_id requestId, r.user_id userId, u.user_name userName, coalesce(p.real_name, u.nick_name) realName, r.source_status sourceStatus, r.target_status targetStatus, r.request_status requestStatus, r.reason, r.credit_related creditRelated, r.requester_id requesterId, r.requester_name requesterName, r.reviewer_id reviewerId, r.reviewer_name reviewerName, r.review_comment reviewComment, r.request_version version, r.create_time createTime, r.update_time updateTime, r.resolved_time resolvedTime, p.service_status currentServiceStatus, p.review_status reviewStatus, coalesce(p.credit_score, 100) creditScore from expert_status_request r join expert_profile p on p.user_id = r.user_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = r.user_id where ( r.target_status = 'EXITED' or (r.source_status = 'CREDIT_BLOCKED' and r.target_status = 'AVAILABLE') )
and r.request_status = #{requestStatus}
and coalesce(p.real_name, u.nick_name) like concat('%', #{realName}, '%')
and u.user_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%')
order by case when r.request_status = 'PENDING' then 0 else 1 end, r.request_id desc
mapper.update: update expert_status_request set request_status = #{requestStatus}, reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, reviewer_name = #{reviewerName}, review_comment = #{reviewComment}, resolved_time = sysdate(), request_version = request_version + 1, update_time = sysdate() where request_id = #{requestId} and request_status = 'PENDING' and ( target_status = 'EXITED' or (source_status = 'CREDIT_BLOCKED' and target_status = 'AVAILABLE') ) and request_version = #{expectedVersion}

update expert_status_request set request_status = 'CANCELLED', reviewer_name = #{operatorName}, review_comment = #{comment}, resolved_time = sysdate(), request_version = request_version + 1, update_time = sysdate() where user_id = #{userId} and request_status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: select count(1) from expert_status_request where request_status = 'PENDING' and ( target_status = 'EXITED' or (source_status = 'CREDIT_BLOCKED' and target_status = 'AVAILABLE') )

insert into expert_approved (user_id, real_name, organization, research_field, industry_field, service_region, service_status, source_material_id, graph_version, approved_by, approved_time, snapshot_json) values (#{profile.userId}, #{profile.realName}, #{profile.organization}, #{profile.researchField}, #{profile.industryField}, #{profile.serviceRegion}, #{profile.serviceStatus}, #{materialId}, #{profile.graphVersion}, #{approvedBy}, sysdate(), #{snapshotJson}) on duplicate key update real_name = values(real_name), organization = values(organization), research_field = values(research_field), industry_field = values(industry_field), service_region = values(service_region), service_status = values(service_status), source_material_id = values(source_material_id), graph_version = values(graph_version), approved_by = values(approved_by), approved_time = sysdate(), snapshot_json = values(snapshot_json)
mapper.select:
select p.user_id userId, p.real_name realName, u.user_name userName, p.organization, p.professional_title professionalTitle, p.research_field researchField, p.industry_field industryField, p.review_status reviewStatus, p.service_status serviceStatus, p.profile_completion profileCompletion, p.latest_submit_time latestSubmitTime, m.material_id materialId, m.file_name fileName, m.job_status jobStatus, m.review_status materialReviewStatus, m.issue_count issueCount, m.agent_message agentMessage from expert_profile p left join sys_user u on u.user_id = p.user_id left join expert_material m on m.material_id = ( select max(m2.material_id) from expert_material m2 where m2.user_id = p.user_id ) where ( p.review_status in ('PENDING_REVIEW', 'REVIEWING', 'RETURNED') or ( m.job_status in ('REVIEW_PENDING', 'PRE_REVIEW_PASSED') and m.review_status in ('PENDING', 'PENDING_REVIEW') ) or (m.job_status = 'FAILED' and p.review_status != 'APPROVED') ) and p.del_flag = '0'
and p.real_name like concat('%', #{realName}, '%')
and p.research_field like concat('%', #{researchField}, '%')
and p.review_status = #{reviewStatus}
order by p.latest_submit_time is null, p.latest_submit_time desc, p.user_id desc

select p.user_id userId, p.real_name realName, p.organization, p.professional_title professionalTitle, p.research_field researchField, p.industry_field industryField, p.service_region serviceRegion, p.phone, p.email, p.career_summary careerSummary, p.review_status reviewStatus, p.service_status serviceStatus, p.profile_completion profileCompletion, p.latest_submit_time latestSubmitTime, u.user_name userName, u.nick_name nickName, m.material_id materialId, m.file_name fileName, m.file_path filePath, m.file_type fileType, m.material_category materialCategory, m.job_status jobStatus, m.review_status materialReviewStatus, m.extracted_fields extractedFields, m.issue_count issueCount, m.agent_message agentMessage, m.review_comment reviewComment from expert_profile p left join sys_user u on u.user_id = p.user_id left join expert_material m on m.material_id = ( select max(m2.material_id) from expert_material m2 where m2.user_id = p.user_id ) where p.user_id = #{userId} and p.del_flag = '0'

select ea.approved_id approvedId, ea.user_id userId, ea.real_name realName, ea.organization, ea.research_field researchField, ea.industry_field industryField, ea.service_region serviceRegion, ea.service_status serviceStatus, ea.graph_version graphVersion, ea.approved_by approvedBy, ea.approved_time approvedTime from expert_approved ea join expert_profile p on p.user_id = ea.user_id and p.review_status = 'APPROVED' and p.del_flag = '0'
and ea.real_name like concat('%', #{realName}, '%')
and ea.research_field like concat('%', #{researchField}, '%')
and ea.service_status = #{serviceStatus}
order by ea.approved_time desc
select count(1) from expert_approved ea join expert_profile p on p.user_id = ea.user_id and p.review_status = 'APPROVED' and p.del_flag = '0'

mapper.insert: insert ignore into expert_object_cleanup (object_uri, task_status, attempt_count, next_retry_time, create_time, update_time) values (#{objectUri}, 'PENDING', 0, sysdate(), sysdate(), sysdate())
mapper.select: select cleanup_id cleanupId, object_uri objectUri, task_status taskStatus, attempt_count attemptCount from expert_object_cleanup where task_status = 'PENDING' and next_retry_time <= sysdate() order by cleanup_id limit #{limit}

update expert_object_cleanup set attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, next_retry_time = date_add(sysdate(), interval least(attempt_count + 1, 60) minute), last_error = #{lastError}, update_time = sysdate() where cleanup_id = #{cleanupId}
mapper.select: select m.user_id userId, m.material_id materialId, m.material_category materialCategory, a.angle_name angleName, m.file_name fileName, m.valid_until expiryDate, case when m.valid_until < curdate() then 'EXPIRED' else 'EXPIRING' end reminderType, datediff(m.valid_until, curdate()) daysRemaining from expert_material m join expert_certification_angle a on a.category_code = m.material_category where a.validity_required = '1' and a.enabled = '0' and m.review_status = 'APPROVED' and m.valid_until is not null and m.valid_until <= date_add(curdate(), interval #{days} day) and m.material_id = ( select max(latest_m.material_id) from expert_material latest_m where latest_m.user_id = m.user_id and latest_m.material_category = m.material_category ) order by m.valid_until, m.user_id
mapper.insert: insert into expert_qualification_reminder (user_id, material_id, material_category, expiry_date, reminder_type, reminder_status, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{materialId}, #{materialCategory}, #{expiryDate}, #{reminderType}, 'ACTIVE', sysdate(), sysdate()) on duplicate key update user_id = values(user_id), material_category = values(material_category), expiry_date = values(expiry_date), reminder_status = 'ACTIVE', update_time = sysdate()
mapper.update: update expert_qualification_reminder r set r.reminder_status = 'RESOLVED', r.update_time = sysdate() where r.reminder_status = 'ACTIVE' and not exists ( select 1 from expert_material m join expert_certification_angle a on a.category_code = m.material_category and a.validity_required = '1' and a.enabled = '0' where m.material_id = r.material_id and m.review_status = 'APPROVED' and m.valid_until is not null and m.valid_until <= date_add(curdate(), interval #{days} day) and m.material_id = ( select max(latest_m.material_id) from expert_material latest_m where latest_m.user_id = m.user_id and latest_m.material_category = m.material_category ) )
mapper.select: select r.reminder_id reminderId, r.user_id userId, r.material_id materialId, r.material_category materialCategory, a.angle_name angleName, m.file_name fileName, r.expiry_date expiryDate, r.reminder_type reminderType, datediff(r.expiry_date, curdate()) daysRemaining, r.create_time createTime from expert_qualification_reminder r join expert_material m on m.material_id = r.material_id join expert_certification_angle a on a.category_code = r.material_category where r.user_id = #{userId} and r.reminder_status = 'ACTIVE' order by r.expiry_date, r.reminder_id
mapper.update: update expert_qualification_reminder set reminder_status = 'RESOLVED', update_time = sysdate() where material_id = #{materialId} and reminder_status = 'ACTIVE'
